build_method: Cargo compact application consumer, dependency-warm unchanged package objects reused; changed units recompiled from verified integrated source, including host compiler and on-target interpreter.
Normal and RELR variants share the exact same application machine-code objects. For the new shipping image the final linker is run twice, toggling only -Wl,-z,pack-relative-relocs.
Each reported build-script and rustc value is one Cargo-unit observation and depends on concurrent work. Cross-crate ThinLTO optimizes again in the separate consumer link.

matched_rustc_source.order: main/shipping/shipping/main; identical two-core affinity, separate OUT_DIRs, isolated from final consumer link.

current_main_compilation.workspace_build_scope: All current-main workspace crates rebuilt with warmed registry units on two cores. No matched whole-workspace timing for the incremental candidate. For matched WinUI units see matched_theme_rustc.

isolated_theme_rustc_method: Interleaved main/shipping/shipping/main unit replays on CPUs 6–7 with the generated full theme and each exact set of Cargo dependency artifacts. Same compact release settings. Excludes XAML generation and the downstream application ThinLTO.

file_cache_eviction.description: Thirty-one rotating fresh processes. Before each launch, fsync and POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED on each tested executable and external archive; record page residency with mincore. Shared libraries, metadata and lower storage caches are warm. No system-wide flush.
